name: Egyptian Rat Screw
tagline: Court cards set challenges, doubles get slapped. Win every card with quick hands and luck.
rulesSummary: All the cards are dealt face down, one pile each. In turn, tap your pile to turn its top card face up onto the middle.

Turn up a court card or an ace and the next player must answer it: they turn up cards until they hit a court card or ace, with 1 try for a jack, 2 for a queen, 3 for a king, 4 for an ace. If they hit one, the challenge passes on. If they don't, whoever set the challenge takes the pile.

Doubles (two of a rank, one on the other) can be slapped by anyone. The quickest hand takes the pile, timed on each player's own screen. The lobby can add sandwiches, top-and-bottom, marriages and tens.
A wrong slap burns one of your cards under the pile.
Out of cards? You're still in: slap your way back.
Win by collecting every card, or set a time limit and the most cards wins.
